question_text:

Luffy and his crew, the Straw Hat Pirates, as he explores the Grand Line in search of the mythical treasure known as the "One Piece" to become the next King of the Pirates. First appearing in 1997, One Piece has since broken the world record for the most copies published for the same comic book series by a single author. In 2023, it was adapted into a Netflix series.

Where is this manga often seen these days?

question_text:

But being the gentleman X was, he interceded on Hawthorn's behalf and the decision was reversed. X won the race, but Hawthorn finished second and also scored a crucial one point for the fastest lap.

As fate would have it, Hawthorn went onto win the Championship by just 1 point (42 vs. X's 41). This was the closest X had come to winning a title, and to his luck, he holds the unwanted record of having won the most GP races (16) without a single title. Id X.
